name: vocabulary_agent_files_init
title: Vocabulary Agent Files
description: Scaffold AGENT_VOCABULARY.md into a directory governed by the agent-files contract, load established words from the workspace's documents and code, merge synonyms onto the most proper words, and append one bounded wording-authority preference to AGENT_HARNESS.md

target_dir.description: Directory holding the agent-files contract where AGENT_VOCABULARY.md will be created

sources.description: Files or directories (documents, code) to scan for the workspace's established words; omit to scaffold the empty template only

overwrite.description: If true, an existing AGENT_VOCABULARY.md is replaced; if false, it is kept, recorded as skipped, and the load-and-merge steps run against the existing file

unmerged_count.description: Number of lines remaining in the Unmerged Words section after the run
